cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're delighted you're staying. I'll put you in our lovely guest room; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll see you in the kitchen after nine; we keep it quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though; I can't make an exception even for a favorite guest. Stay for the later train and I'll choose you our nicest banana.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns the room, A3 decides breakfast time, A5 personally refuses B4 exception while selecting a special banana; highest-status hosting remains sincerely warm through restrictive decisions.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 downstairs plan causes A3 time restriction; B4 train/portable food causes A5 location rule and later-train hospitality.

relationship.evidence: B2 cooperates and B4 offers a reasonable workaround, so restriction is revealed through actual guest needs.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 banana request to add an unwaived location boundary while increasing affectionate attention, developing both halves together.

specificity.evidence: A1 guest room and food rule, A3 nine and B4 eight make the conflict concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 nicest banana is earned by B4 requested food, a small sincere offer rather than detached wit.
